headline: EPL Limited informs the Exchange about a change in its directors
hook: Leadership shift at packaging major EPL
summary: EPL Limited has submitted a regulatory filing to the stock exchanges announcing a change in its board of directors. The company provides packaging solutions globally. Such board changes are standard corporate governance updates for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking EPL should note executive changes as they may influence future strategic direction.
why_it_matters: Routine board reshuffle with minimal immediate impact on stock price.
